meta.name: Marlow Yard (re-plan, J14)
meta.taught_by_note: J12 BRIEF A8 / A9: the section where the last co-op kit move (station 16, drop catch) is taught alone. A7 (one split, no side route; J12 A23 merges a split into one route) and A8 (the Strongroom, the only section that keeps side routes, Q24) come after it. Each lesson is a space tag teach:<move> on the space its move reaches, so no entry-to-exit path avoids it (parallel links such as A1 boost / human ladder and A6 boost / rope cannot carry it). J14 PLAN A13.
meta.note: Re-planned yard (docs/marlow-replan/REPLAN.md), written before any geometry change. Coordinates and sizes from src/world/maps/ctcourseSets/*.ts on master 2148ec96. Targets (sees_pct, los_break_s, drill_s) are declared, not measured (V6 measures at greybox exit). A8 is the one enemy-training area that keeps side routes under campaign-area rules (Q24). The five kit moves added 2026-10-25 ~18:05 have no validator kind yet, so each is drawn with the nearest kind and a `move` field: plank_bridge as pair_gate (A2), deadweight as shutter (A4), chimney_pair as team_rope (A5), swing_pass as team_throw (A5, `gap_m` beyond the throw), drop_catch as drop (A6). Their stations ship when the move is built (BRIEF A3).

spaces.function: Arrival armoury: both players start here
Lorry apron in front of the 4.4 m yard wall: the striped leg-up mark
Gate checker's cabin: the yard light switches and the seated checker (blind and deaf: grab and questioning practice, his two lines are the intel)
Top of the yard wall: the boosted player stands here, then hangs down for the relay
Goods yard behind the wall, to holding room one
Holding room one: checkpoint for A2, glass slot onto the stores bay
Stores bay inside the shed's west door: the shunter's cabin opens off it; the roller door into the running shed
Shunter's cabin: isolator cabinet one and the cabin light switch (cut it to wait in the dark)
Gap between the road 2 and road 3 vans: the waiting spot; its east mouth is the vantage, behind the shunter's back
Shunting neck: a 10 m crossing under four caged high-bays, the shunter's post facing east down it
spaces.note: Estimate: the gap mouth (x 45.6, z 12.5) sees the whole neck width; the shunter faces east, so it is behind him. Drill: each crossing inside the 15 s dark; the lights back on with a player in the neck retries that crossing.

spaces.function: East end, near side of the open wheel-drop pit: isolator cabinet two (moved to this side) and the stack of scaffold boards
Far side of the 3 m wheel-drop pit across the shed's east end (covers lifted for the night): the L2 door
spaces.note: Plank Bridge station. The shunter faces east down the neck, so a board left lying in the light is noticed: lay it while the neck is dark or pull it in after (Q11: the lesson needs his eyes).

spaces.function: Holding room two: checkpoint for A3
West lift lobby: the corridor fire door is locked out of hours; the riser cupboard opens on the services crawl
Office corridor under the east-end IR camera: the jam relay, with the recess halfway as the stepping stone
spaces.note: Drill: each hop inside one jam (5 s held plus the 1.5 s reboot); seen by the camera retries that hop from its start mark. No guard: the camera is the threat (Q11).

spaces.function: East lift lobby under and behind the camera, to holding room three
Holding room three: checkpoint for A4; its glass slot looks into the security room
Security room (the foreman's office mock-up): the duty officer at the monitors; his console loops the floor cameras for 60 s
spaces.note: custom: 6 x 6 is 1 m short of the security_room class length (7.0); kept as built (a WARN to justify). Vantage: L3's glass slot beside its far door.

spaces.function: Staff passage under the gallery from the security room to the goods floor
Back aisle's east end and the cross aisle up to the main aisle (the west back aisle, aisle 2, the east lane and the mezzanine are closed by pallet end frames)
Main aisle under cameras C1-C3: cross it to the dock inside the 60 s camera loop
spaces.note: Drill: from the console press to west of x 84 inside the 60 s loop; the cameras rebooting with a player in view retries the crossing (console re-arms at once, players back to the passage mouth).

spaces.function: Dock: the two loaders talking at the dispatch desk, taken together inside 1.5 s
spaces.note: Vantage: crouched behind rack row R2's west end frame (x 86, z 36). Drill: the synced takedown inside 1.5 s; one man taken alone retries (the pair reset at the desk). The kettle break that split them is removed.

spaces.function: Holding room four: checkpoint for A5, wall medkit
The 1 m gap between holding room four's outer wall and the substation's 6 m perimeter wall: L4's far door opens into it
spaces.note: Chimney Pair station: too high for a boost (4.5 m) and no other way up, so both brace back to back and climb together. No guard (Q11).

spaces.function: Top of the perimeter wall: the fixed access ladder down the inside to the apron
Apron's east strip at the foot of the ladder, the near side of the open cable trench (re-cabling works, cable drums beside it)
spaces.note: Swing Pass station: the trench is 3.5 m across, past the 2.7 m throw; braced on the cable-tray gantry over it, one swings the other across; the far one lays the trench plates for his partner. No guard needed; the patrol's round stays in the inner zone.

spaces.function: Apron's west strip past the trench: the throw mark at the beam gateway
Inner zone: the patrol's round, the floodlit strip in front of the release kiosk, a static watcher at the kiosk facing the strip
spaces.guards_note: Patrol plus one static watcher at the release kiosk facing the floodlit strip (Michael ~20:40 "12, add two"; J14 PLAN Guards per lesson): with the patrol alone the strip is unwatched for part of his round and the pair could wait him out; the watcher makes the floodlight jam necessary. Seen in the floodlight: retry from behind the transformer.
spaces.note: Drill: the thrown player crosses the floodlit 8 m and keys the release inside one floodlight jam (5 s held plus 4 s off); seen in the flood retries from the lee. Breaking a beam also retries: the release ignores a player who walked the beams.

spaces.function: Lee of transformer pen 2 where the throw lands: the transformer screens the floodlight (shadow from cover, not a dead lamp)
Holding room five: checkpoint for A6
Old sump bay inside the L5 door (its high-bay re-lamped, switch by the door): crouched behind the kerb you watch the attendant's round
Pump floor: three pumps, the attendant's gauge round; the gallery's loading edge at the west end
spaces.note: Vantage estimate: from the kerb's west opening (49.4, 58) down the pump row; measure at greybox.

spaces.function: Motor gallery at 4.4 m: the davit box's rescue line; a self-closing gate on the loading edge
Bridge over the drive cage: the gland plate; the hanger holds the isolate key while the holder watches the attendant
spaces.note: Not a timed drill: timing against the attendant's round. A hanger who lets go before the key retries the hang-down (the key is reachable only from the hang). After the key the hanger drops into the drive pit and the holder, alone on top with only the 6 m drop, comes down by the Drop Catch.

spaces.function: The drive pit inside the cage, sunk 1.6 m below the pump floor (new at build): the low-level outfall door to holding room six, and the cage's push-bar door up to the floor (opens from inside only)
spaces.note: Drop Catch station: the way on is only through the pit, and the pit is only entered from the bridge. A heavy landing (above 4.5 m) is loud and the attendant's round passes 6 m away, so the holder drops into the hanger's arms. Heard by the attendant retries the catch from the bridge.

spaces.function: Holding room six: checkpoint for A7
Entry lobby: a glazed screen onto the rack hall, the plant corridor door, the fire plan

Rack hall: the technician's round on rows 1-2 and the north camera; terminal one on the cage's west face; a second technician's round along the hall's east side crosses the pod approach, in view of the hall leg through the cage mesh
spaces.guards_note: The rows 1-2 technician plus station 17's pod-leg technician (Michael ~20:40 "12, add two"; J14 PLAN Guards per lesson). The second one's round runs from the hall's east side across the pod approach and back, so the hall player sees him through the cage mesh and covers the pod player, as the pod player covers the hall: two-way cover. Counted here, not on a7-pod: the pod stays a quiet connector with no guard (level-design 3.8). Seen: retry that step.
spaces.note: Vantage: the lobby's new full-height glazed screen (x 76, z 56-66) looks down all three east-west aisles and the cage front.

spaces.function: Plant corridor: cooling units, the loud trench grating, the sweeping camera at its east door; the hall's lighting panel at its west end

Hot-aisle pod: terminal two on the cage's east face; through the mesh it overlooks the hall player's approach; the pod-leg technician (counted on a7-hall) crosses its approach, so the pod player waits on the hall player's call
spaces.note: Drill: both terminals inside 1.5 s on the ready lamps; a miss resets the terminals in place (no damage in Marlow).

spaces.function: The client's cage: both doors open on the synced hack, where the split rejoins
Holding room seven: the scale model of A8, wall medkit, checkpoint for A8
Vestibule under the gallery's west return, now with wall lights on their own switch
Banking hall: the night clerk's post, the hall patrol to the grille, camera C1; leg-up or the public stair to the gallery
Floor route behind the oak counters, out of the clerk's sweep; the jam on C2 is made from here
Strip under the gallery's north run: the lighting board that isolates the hall's night circuit and the grille's lock
spaces.note: Drill: the 25 s dark opens the grille; the lights back on relocks it and the isolation retries.

spaces.function: Gallery's west return over the vestibule: the leg-up lands here
Gallery's north run: its last 10 m under camera C2, covered by the floor partner's jam
Security office at gallery level, glazed onto the gallery: the duty officer; his console loops C1-C3 for 60 s
spaces.note: Vantage: the office's west wall becomes a glazed screen (a real security office overlooks its hall); the officer sits with his back to it.

spaces.function: Vault lobby's outer zone: time lock one, the office stair's foot door, the grille from the hall
Vault lobby's inner zone past the beam curtain: time lock two by the vault door
spaces.note: Drill: the throw and the paired hack inside the 60 s camera loop; the loop ending retries from the office console (re-arms at once).

spaces.function: The vault, open at its back to the cash dock
Cash dock: both players in the exit zone end the course
